title: Rapid Repeated Authentication Failures on Web Portal
summary: 15 failed authentication attempts observed in 45 seconds from single source IP against simulated employee portal.
detection_explanation: Source exceeded threshold of 10 failed logins within 60 seconds against isolated honeypot portal WEB-001.

evidence.summary: 15 failed authentication submissions with distinct password length patterns within 45s window

mitre_attack.mapping_evidence: Sequential authentication failures with varied credentials targeting single web service endpoint.

recommendations.recommended_action: Apply temporary rate-limiting or firewall block for source IP 198.51.100.45 at perimeter edge.
recommendations.recommendation_reason: High-velocity automated authentication probe detected against isolated decoy.
